New volunteers feel overwhelmed by the board

Status
recurring
Symptom
board-too-complex
First seen
2026-02-01
Last seen
2026-04-27
Equipment
Main sound board

What's happening

Several of our newer volunteers don't feel confident at the board, especially when something unexpected happens. They mostly know how to push faders but don't know what to do if a channel goes silent or feedback starts.

What's been tried

  • Walked through the board with two new volunteers individually
  • Created a one-page cheat sheet (lost after a few weeks)

This site is partly a response to this issue — the troubleshoot pages and learn articles are aimed directly at this.

Suggestion

No approved suggestion exists for this symptom yet. A rule exists but is still in draft — it needs a reviewer's approval. Try the symptom page or ask an experienced volunteer.

Suggestions on this site are guidance, not professional advice. If you are unsure, stop and ask an experienced sound engineer.
